name: Pension Transfer Scope 1 Code
definition: Specifies the scope of a pension transfer.

CRYS.definition: Transfer is for the crystallised portion.

SDDT.name: Drawdown Tranche
SDDT.definition: Transfer is for a specific drawdown tranche.

FULP.name: Full Pension

UCRY.name: Uncrystallised Part
UCRY.definition: Transfer is for the uncrystallised portion.
